name: Axiomatic PArmv8 (PArmv8axiom)
description: Cho et al.'s declarative Armv8 persistency model, which simplifies and fixes documented flaws in Raad et al.'s PARMv8. Formally, they prove (Thm 6.1) that PArmv8axiom is equivalent to SPArmv8, a strengthening of PARMv8, and (Thm 6.2) that it is equivalent to the operational PArmv8view. This axiomatic model has been reviewed by Arm engineers; the crash-free behaviour coincides with Armv8.

catSupport.note: Declarative persistency axioms over Armv8 executions (aarch64.cat plus a persist-order axiom in shape); no cat model exists for the persistency dimension.
